climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Bulgarian PDO whose rules allow Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot for red, and Chardonnay, Dimiat, Muscat Ottonel, Riesling, Sauvignon Blanc and Traminer for white.
